protocol: Demanding aerobic session at 75% of baseline VO2max before the intervention (visit 2) in both groups; VO2, RER and blood lactate in Table 4; the supplement period (16 days) comes after; read the placebo column and the pre-intervention columns
population: 29 recreationally active adults, 42 +/- 2 y, split into placebo and olive-phytocomplex groups
note: Table headed mean +/- SE; the bout is the pre-intervention session, so both groups are untreated at that point; lactate only once per session.
